arguments.title: DreamSim: Learning New Dimensions of Human Visual Similarity using Synthetic Data
key_claims: Human similarity supervision makes the embedding sensitive to color/layout beyond purely semantic baselines. However, its analysis emphasizes foreground objects over backgrounds and its synthetic dataset is object-centric; this is a poor match to person-masked lighting backgrounds. Therefore it is a possible secondary diagnostic only after controlled-light perturbation validation, not a primary lighting-quality metric. Do not evaluate a feature teacher with the same embedding and call agreement independent evidence. Actual music-fit/design preference remains a separate human endpoint.
